2 فَصَّعْتُهُ مِنْ كَذَا , inf. n. تَفْصِيعٌ, I made it to go, or come, forth from such a thing. (IAar, S, L, TA.) ―
-b2- See also 1, last sentence, in two places. ―
-b3- Accord. to Lth, فصّع, inf. n. as above, is also used in relation to a stink, and the ordure of a child, and a noiseless emission of wind from the anus: (O:) [or] it means He emitted wind from the anus with a sound: or without a sound. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
